Dear {Mr_Ms}. {name},

Sub: APPOINTMENT ORDER - REG.

        We welcome you to our organization “Shine Craft Technologies” and we are pleased to appoint you as {Role} for a period of {time_period} on the following terms and conditions. On satisfactory completion of the probation period, you will be confirmed in our Organization.

Date of Joining: This appointment order will be effective from {DOJ} {MOJ} {YOJ}.

Grade: You are fixed in Grade - {level} in our roll.

Duties & Responsibilities

A detailed schedule of your duties and responsibilities, including the development and maintenance of the website, server, and database for our projects and products, will be provided to you upon joining our organization. However, the company reserves the right

 

Page 2 of 2

to assign to you such other duties and responsibilities. You will report to our COO, Project Manager & Senior Developer or to any other team members mentioned by them.

 We expect your long term commitment in Shine Craft Technologies.

You are requested to go through this appointment letter and sign the duplicate copy as a token of having accepted the terms of appointment.

You are advised to report for duty on {DOJ} {MOJ} {YOJ} failing which this appointment order will be treated as cancelled.

"With Best Wishes"

 

For Shine Craft Technologies.,

 

 

 

(Ajith Kumar V)

Founder and COO

 

 

 

Declaration

I hereby declare that I have read and accept all the above terms and conditions.

 

 

SIGNATURE & DATE

 

 

 

 

 

1.     Your Salary Structure per month are as follows

Basic

 

 

DA

 

 

HRA

 

 

Special Allowance

 

 

Other Allowance

 

 

 

 

 

TOTAL CTC PER MONTH

 

 

 

2.     Leave

You will be eligible for a total leave of 14 days for the first year out of which you are permitted to avail only 1 day leave in a month. If leaves are unavailed for 2 or 3 months those leaves can be taken continuously when required.

 

3.     Working Hours

You should follow the work timings/rules applicable to Head office.

 

4.     Resignation 

If you want to resign from the service of the organization, you are required to give 30 days’ notice prior to your date of resignation.

 

5.     General

1. If you are unable to carry out the jobs continuously due to health / weather / language problems / home sickness etc., Company will not be responsible for further suitable placements.

2. You are responsible for the safekeeping and return in good condition and order of all the Company's properties which are used by you or in your custody / charge.

3. You should devote your full time and attention to the work assigned to you.

You should at all times obey and abide by the lawful directions and orders given to you by your superiors and work diligently, faithfully with your full cooperation

 

and co-ordination with management and team members. The Company shall be the sole judge to determine whether the work assigned to you is suitable or not and you shall not cease performing a part or the whole of your duties unilaterally.

4. In case you remain absent continuously for a period of ten consecutive days without intimating or prior permission or if you over stay leave for a period of 10 consecutive days, it will be deemed that you are not interested in your employment and have abandoned. In such circumstances your employment comes to an end automatically.

5. Notwithstanding the other terms set out here in above, this company has absolute rights at any time to terminate your services without any notice or without compensation in lieu of notice for your committing any breach of the terms of this letter of appointment or if you are found guilty of any insubordination, insolence, gross negligence of duty, irregularities etc,

6. This order is issued subject to the validation of documents submitted by you.

7. Your address, as indicated in your application shall be deemed to be correct for sending any communication to you. Any change in address should be communicated to us in writing.

8. You shall keep the Company informed of any change in your residential address or civil status. This appointment order is being made on the basis of particulars in respect of Education, Experience etc. & in case any information furnished by you is found to be false or incorrect, your appointment order will be

deemed void initio & you shall be terminated without any notice or salary in lieu thereof.

 

 

 

 

 

We expect your long term commitment in Shine Craft Technologies.

 

You are requested to go through this appointment letter and sign the duplicate copy as a token of having accepted the terms of appointment.

You are advised to report for duty on {DOJ} {MOJ} {YOJ} failing which this appointment order will be treated as cancelled.

"With Best Wishes"

 

 

Sincerely,

(Ajith Kumar V)

Founder and COO
